notes.title: Update v1.0.0.4
notes.notes:
Update v1.0.0.4 is now live

Patch notes:

Gameplay settings:
NPC Healthbar indicator toggle
NPC Healthbars showing on player proximity toggle
Daytime Brightness adjustment levels
Night time Brightness adjustment levels
Day Length (Real time length of daylight in minutes)
10, 20, 30, 60

Video settings:
Graphics Quality
Shadow Quality
Anti-Aliasing Quality
Post Process Quality
Resolution sizes (Additional sizes available upon request)
1920 x 1080
1440 x 900
1366 x 768
1024 x 678
vSync toggle
Gamma level adjustments

Players now have the option to either quit the application or quit to main menu


Miscellaneous:
Unarmed Player sprint speed increased
NPC spawn locations and rates adjusted
NPC walk/run speeds adjusted
NPC damage and aggro cool down rates adjusted
Loot drop rates and quantities modified
Player inventory base max weight has been increased
Small and large backpack additional weight benefits increased
Item weights have been modified
Item recipes have been adjusted
Tool (wood axes and pickaxes) collection amount rates have been balanced
Player fall impact damage/velocity decreased
Player death and respawn mechanics have been changed
-Players will not drop inventory items on death, instead players will be redirected back to the main menu to either start a new game, load a previous save (remember to save often) or rage quit if desired.
Removed duplicate foliage instances

Bug fixes:
Save file will not become massive at 8+ hours of game play anymore (requires start of new game)



*****Starting a new game is recommended but not required (some of the added features and changes will not work off a previous save file) *****

notes.title: Progress Report
notes.notes:
Here's a quick update on what I've been working on lately. I'm currently wrapping up the testing phase for the next patch. Players can expect the following modifications:

The pause menu has been completely overhauled. Audio, Video and Gameplay settings will now be accessible. All settings will also save and load properly.

Gameplay settings include:
NPC Healthbar indicator toggle
NPC Healthbars showing on player proximity toggle
Daytime Brightness adjustment levels
Night time Brightness adjustment levels
Day Length (Real time length of daylight in minutes)
	10, 20, 30, 60

Video settings include:
Graphics Quality
Shadow Quality
Anti-Aliasing Quality
Post Process Quality
Resolution sizes (Additional sizes available upon request)
	1920 x 1080
	1440 x 900
	1366 x 768
	1024 x 678
vSync  toggle 
Gamma level adjustments

Players now have the option to either quit the application or quit to main menu

Audio settings are coming in a later update. Coming soon menu page set as a  place holder as of now.

Miscellaneous modifications include:
NPC spawn locations and rates adjusted
Loot drop rates and quantities modified
Player inventory base max weight has been increased
Small and large backpack additional weight benefits increased
Item weights have been modified
Tool (wood axes and pickaxes) collection amount rates have been balanced
Player fall impact damage/velocity decreased 
Player death and respawn mechanics have been changed
    -Players will not drop inventory items on death, instead players will be redirected back to the main menu to either start a new game, load a previous save or rage quit if desired. 

I was also able to confirm an issue that several players have reported with longer game saves (8+ hours) not being able to load properly. This update should resolve these issues. My current test save has 30+ hours and is loading as intended. I will continue running tests on this and report back with additional findings.

I will make this update live as soon as the testing phase has been completed successfully.

notes.title: Expectations
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 

I wanted to thank you guys for your feedback and let you know that they have all been received. I'm currently working on the following improvements/ modifications;

*Additional customization in the settings menu as well as loading them properly from save files
     *Resolution
     *Gamma
     *Brightness
     *NPC nameplate/hp indicators
     *Day/Night cycle length
     *Audio adjustments

*Additional sound effects

*Additional food/thirst resources, recipes and direct sources. 

*Adjusting item weights

****All items in this list are subject to change****

Once these changes have been implemented/ tested I will make the update live.

I would also like to take this time to clarify a few things. All comments and emails are read daily I will not be replying to every single one of them. Most communication will come from the News/ Announcement board. Unless there is some sort of an emergency where Einn is rendered function-less, I will not be commenting on the discussion boards or applying updates during the weekends. Operating hours will be Monday - Friday, 8:00 am to 6:00 pm MST (USA). Please adjust expectations accordingly.

notes.title: Early Access Now Available!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

I am pleased to announce that EINN is now available for Early Access! 

I would like to take this time to quickly thank everyone for their kind words and interest so far. The amount of support I have received up to this point has been unexpected and greatly appreciated! 

What's next?

Depending upon the amount of feedback I receive I hope to have my first pre-patch notes up in a month or so. In that note I will list the improvements/changes I have planned for the next patch as well as some of the top most requested improvements from the community.
